sloka: अलंकारो हि नारीणाम् क्षमा तु पुरुषस्य वा ।दुष्करम् तत् च वै क्षान्तम् त्रिदशेषु विशेषतः ॥१-३३-७॥
transliteration: alaṁkāro hi nārīṇām kṣamā tu puruṣasya vā ।duṣkaram tat ca vai kṣāntam tridaśeṣu viśeṣataḥ ॥1-33-7॥

translations.english: Whether for women or men forgiveness is an ornament. It is difficult even for gods. For you, daughters, to show it without any difference of opinion is especially hard.
